recognized.hugen_family_canonical_decision: The 9 deprecated subdomains' only off-host source is the SHARED operator handle x.com/ishinabegen, which corroborates the existence of the hugen.tokyo family operator (paid twitter_search confirmed the handle self-declares ~10 x402 endpoints) but provides NO independent off-host NAMING of each specific subdomain product. None of these 9 pages publishes the operator handle on-page (verified: 'no operator handle on-page' for all 9). Per the off_host_required rule, recognition needs off-host corroboration of the specific recognition; family-level operator corroboration is insufficient per-subdomain. display_name retained for all 9 (home pages support the names verbatim). Only tick.hugen.tokyo had an on-page handle + product-specific timeline match, so its recognition was kept. Additionally, all is_recognized=true facts were applied single-source on the host's own domain (the recognizer's documented off-host sources were not attached to the facts as evidence — evidence table empty), reinforcing the off_host_required reading.
